test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Annoy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gratify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Annoy"** means to irritate or disturb someone, causing them to feel slightly angry or bothered. (परेशान करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her constant humming began to annoy everyone in the office.
 
 
 
• **"Gratify" **refers to giving pleasure or satisfaction to someone. (संतुष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Receiving praise for his work always gratifies him.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Annoy'** is **'Gratify'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Gratify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vex **(चिढ़ाना): To make someone feel annoyed or worried.

 
 
• **Example:** The constant delays began to vex the passengers.
 
 
 
• **Irritate **(झुंझलाना): To annoy someone, especially by making them feel impatient or slightly angry.
 
 
• **Example: **His habit of interrupting others started to irritate his friends.
 
 
 
• **Thrill** (रोमांचित करना): To cause someone to feel very excited or happy.
 
 
• **Example:** The roller coaster ride thrilled the children.
